projects.title: LoopLedger
projects.problemSolved: Loop-heavy scripts hid off-by-one errors and silent double processing.
projects.keyMechanism: Instrumented every loop with counters and explicit invariants, then compared while/for variants against edge-case fixtures.
projects.lesson: The habit of writing the loop invariant before the loop became the default for every later data pipeline.

projects.title: TypeTape
projects.problemSolved: Dynamic types let bad values travel deep into a program before failing.
projects.keyMechanism: Added typed boundaries with typing hints plus cheap runtime assertions at input edges, covered by table-driven tests.
projects.lesson: Type hints were treated as documentation with teeth rather than decorative annotations.

projects.title: StringFoundry
projects.problemSolved: Text assembly grew quadratic as reports got larger.
projects.keyMechanism: Benchmarked concatenation against ''.join and f-strings with timeit across small and large corpora.
projects.lesson: A one-line benchmark settled a debate that had produced weeks of guesswork.

projects.title: ConditionMaze
projects.problemSolved: Nested conditionals made business rules impossible to review.
projects.keyMechanism: Flattened the decision tree into guard clauses and a truth table that doubled as test cases.
projects.lesson: Guard clauses turned implicit branching into an auditable rule sheet.

projects.title: FunctionForge
projects.problemSolved: Helpers mutated shared state, so results depended on call order.
projects.keyMechanism: Split each helper into a pure core plus a thin I/O shell with explicit inputs and outputs.
projects.lesson: Pure cores made unit tests fast and made later concurrency work safe.

projects.title: RecursionRuler
projects.problemSolved: Recursive solutions failed with opaque stack traces on deep inputs.
projects.keyMechanism: Added depth guards, memoization and an iterative counterpart to compare stack behaviour.
projects.lesson: Recursion became a deliberate choice with a documented depth budget.

projects.title: ExceptionAtlas
projects.problemSolved: Broad except blocks swallowed the exact information needed to debug failures.
projects.keyMechanism: Built a small exception taxonomy with structured traceback capture and re-raise boundaries.
projects.lesson: Every failure now arrives with context, not just a stack trace.

projects.title: FileCabinet
projects.problemSolved: Encoding assumptions and partial writes corrupted generated files.
projects.keyMechanism: Used pathlib, explicit UTF-8 and atomic temp-file replacement with cleanup on failure.
projects.lesson: Atomic writes eliminated half-written artifacts after interrupted runs.

projects.title: RegexRanger
projects.problemSolved: Ad-hoc regular expressions matched far more than intended.
projects.keyMechanism: Compiled named patterns once, annotated them with verbose mode and pinned behaviour with property-style tests.
projects.lesson: Named groups made extracted fields self-documenting in downstream code.

projects.title: TestBench
projects.problemSolved: Manual verification could not keep pace with small refactors.
projects.keyMechanism: Created a table-driven unittest suite with reusable fixtures and a one-command runner.
projects.lesson: A fast test suite made the rest of the 100 projects safe to build on.

projects.title: ArrayAligner
projects.problemSolved: Index maths produced subtle off-by-one bugs at both ends of a list.
projects.keyMechanism: Documented slice invariants and drove tests from boundary pairs instead of happy paths.
projects.lesson: Boundary-first tests caught defects that random examples consistently missed.

projects.title: StackSentry
projects.problemSolved: Push/pop stacks leaked items and overflowed without warning.
projects.keyMechanism: Implemented a capped stack with explicit capacity, invariant checks and deterministic drain tests.
projects.lesson: Capacity became a design parameter instead of an accident.

projects.title: QueueTrack
projects.problemSolved: FIFO consumers processed work out of order under load.
projects.keyMechanism: Replaced list-based queues with collections.deque and asserted ordering plus drain semantics.
projects.lesson: The same deque pattern reappeared in later queue and lag projects.

projects.title: HashHarbor
projects.problemSolved: Key design choices caused collisions and unpredictable lookup costs.
projects.keyMechanism: Probed dict behaviour with collision-heavy keys and visualised distribution before choosing a key scheme.
projects.lesson: Good key design proved cheaper than any clever lookup optimisation.

projects.title: TreeTracer
projects.problemSolved: Traversal order bugs corrupted assembled nested documents.
projects.keyMechanism: Implemented recursive and iterative DFS/BFS side by side and compared emitted paths.
projects.lesson: Having two traversals act as cross-checks exposed ordering assumptions quickly.

projects.title: GraphGuide
projects.problemSolved: Cyclic dependencies hung a naive walker.
projects.keyMechanism: Added visited sets, cycle reporting and a topological sort for dependency graphs.
projects.lesson: Cycle detection became a prerequisite for every later graph-shaped tool.

projects.title: SortSpectrum
projects.problemSolved: Teams reached for the same sort regardless of input shape.
projects.keyMechanism: Measured built-in and reference sorts over random, reversed and nearly sorted data.
projects.lesson: The benchmark showed that stability and input shape matter more than folklore.

projects.title: SearchScope
projects.problemSolved: Binary search failed on empty, single and duplicate-heavy inputs.
projects.keyMechanism: Used lower/upper bound invariants with loop termination proofs and exhaustive small-array tests.
projects.lesson: Invariant-driven searching removed a whole class of boundary bugs.

projects.title: HeapHelper
projects.problemSolved: Priority queues produced unstable ordering for equal keys.
projects.keyMechanism: Wrapped heapq entries with monotonic tie-break counters and verified deterministic pop order.
projects.lesson: Deterministic heaps made replay and debugging possible.

projects.title: CacheCanvas
projects.problemSolved: A hand-rolled cache served stale values without a visible expiry rule.
projects.keyMechanism: Built a small TTL plus LRU cache with explicit eviction reasons and hit/miss counters.
projects.lesson: Cache observability was introduced long before the later systems projects needed it.

projects.title: CLIPilot
projects.problemSolved: One-off scripts accumulated dozens of incompatible flags.
projects.keyMechanism: Designed argparse subcommands with shared parents, typed values and friendly validation errors.
projects.lesson: A consistent CLI grammar made every later tool self-describing.

projects.title: ConfigCompass
projects.problemSolved: Configuration lived in code, files and environment variables with no precedence rule.
projects.keyMechanism: Layered environment over file defaults, parsed values into typed objects and printed a redacted resolution trace.
projects.lesson: Explaining where a value came from ended most configuration incidents.

projects.title: LogLoom
projects.problemSolved: Print statements made production logs impossible to filter or correlate.
projects.keyMechanism: Introduced structured logging with levels, correlation IDs and JSON output for machines.
projects.lesson: Structured logs became the raw material for the observability arc.

projects.title: EnvEcho
projects.problemSolved: Environment drift between laptop and deployment caused mysterious failures.
projects.keyMechanism: Validated .env files against a declared schema and redacted secrets in all diagnostic output.
projects.lesson: Schema-checked environments turned setup into a repeatable contract.

projects.title: PackagePath
projects.problemSolved: Imports broke depending on the directory a script was launched from.
projects.keyMechanism: Established a real package layout, explicit relative imports and an editable install workflow.
projects.lesson: Reliable packaging removed path hacks from every subsequent project.

projects.title: FixtureForge
projects.problemSolved: Random fixtures made test failures irreproducible.
projects.keyMechanism: Replaced randomness with seeded factories that generate deterministic but varied records.
projects.lesson: A failing test could now be replayed exactly.

projects.title: BenchMeter
projects.problemSolved: Performance claims rested on a single lucky run.
projects.keyMechanism: Built repeatable micro-benchmarks with warm-up, medians and simple histograms.
projects.lesson: Reporting distributions instead of single numbers changed how trade-offs were discussed.

projects.title: DocDraft
projects.problemSolved: README examples drifted away from the code they described.
projects.keyMechanism: Generated usage sections from docstrings and ran the examples as part of the test suite.
projects.lesson: Documentation became executable and therefore trustworthy.

projects.title: TaskScheduler
projects.problemSolved: Recurring maintenance depended on someone remembering to run it.
projects.keyMechanism: Built a cron-like scheduler with idempotent run keys and persisted last-success timestamps.
projects.lesson: Idempotency keys prevented duplicate side effects during retries.

projects.title: MigrationMap
projects.problemSolved: Schema changes were applied by hand and could not be rolled back.
projects.keyMechanism: Wrote versioned up/down SQLite migrations with a dry-run mode and integrity checks.
projects.lesson: Migration discipline later underpinned SchemaDiff and ReleaseGate.

projects.title: MarkupModel
projects.problemSolved: Pages relied on generic divs and were unusable with assistive technology.
projects.keyMechanism: Rebuilt the layout from semantic landmarks, labelled controls and a correct heading order.
projects.lesson: Semantics did more for accessibility than any later styling pass.

projects.title: StyleStack
projects.problemSolved: Specificity wars made small visual tweaks risky.
projects.keyMechanism: Introduced design tokens as CSS variables and a strict layering order for component rules.
projects.lesson: Tokens gave the whole archive a single place to change colour and spacing.

projects.title: ResponsiveRails
projects.problemSolved: Fixed-width layouts broke on small screens.
projects.keyMechanism: Adopted mobile-first media queries, fluid grids and clamp-based typography.
projects.lesson: The responsive rules became the baseline for the final catalog grid.

projects.title: FormForge
projects.problemSolved: Forms accepted bad data or announced errors badly.
projects.keyMechanism: Combined native constraints with custom accessible error messages tied via aria-describedby.
projects.lesson: Validation was designed as a conversation with the user, not a wall.

projects.title: TableTuner
projects.problemSolved: Large data tables were impossible to scan or sort reliably.
projects.keyMechanism: Added sticky headers, stable client-side sorting and explicit column scope attributes.
projects.lesson: Tables became readable without abandoning plain HTML.

projects.title: ModalMender
projects.problemSolved: Custom dialogs trapped focus and stranded keyboard users.
projects.keyMechanism: Migrated to the native dialog element with focus return and predictable Escape handling.
projects.lesson: The drawer pattern used later in CenturyVault inherits these rules.

projects.title: ThemeToggle
projects.problemSolved: Pages flashed the wrong theme before JavaScript initialised.
projects.keyMechanism: Persisted a theme choice and applied it with a tiny inline script before first paint.
projects.lesson: Avoiding the flash mattered more than the theme itself.

projects.title: KeyboardKit
projects.problemSolved: Interactive widgets required a mouse.
projects.keyMechanism: Added roving tabindex, visible focus rings and a documented shortcut map.
projects.lesson: Keyboard support turned the UI into a faster tool, not just an accessible one.

projects.title: CanvasClock
projects.problemSolved: Animation stuttered because frame work grew with elapsed time.
projects.keyMechanism: Switched to requestAnimationFrame with delta-time updates and bounded redraw work.
projects.lesson: Delta-time thinking later helped the simulated dashboards stay smooth.

projects.title: StorageShelf
projects.problemSolved: Client state failed after schema changes or quota limits.
projects.keyMechanism: Versioned stored payloads, handled quota errors and built a migration path for old shapes.
projects.lesson: Storage was treated as a small database with its own schema contract.

projects.title: RestRelay
projects.problemSolved: Endpoints disagreed on status codes and response envelopes.
projects.keyMechanism: Defined resource-shaped JSON, consistent error envelopes and a contract test suite.
projects.lesson: A shared contract made client code dramatically simpler.

projects.title: FetchFiber
projects.problemSolved: Network failures left the UI spinning forever.
projects.keyMechanism: Used AbortController, bounded retries with backoff and explicit error states in every view.
projects.lesson: Timeouts and fallbacks became first-class UI states in the final hub.

projects.title: AuthAnchor
projects.problemSolved: Sessions were stored in a way that exposed them to scripts and CSRF.
projects.keyMechanism: Set HttpOnly and SameSite cookies, added CSRF tokens and centralised session checks.
projects.lesson: Security defaults were encoded in one place rather than repeated by hand.

projects.title: WebhookWatch
projects.problemSolved: Retried webhooks created duplicate business records.
projects.keyMechanism: Verified signatures and enforced idempotency keys before any state change.
projects.lesson: Idempotency became the default answer to unreliable delivery.

projects.title: JsonJunction
projects.problemSolved: Malformed payloads produced stack traces instead of useful errors.
projects.keyMechanism: Applied schema validation and translated violations into field-level feedback.
projects.lesson: Good validation errors are an API's user interface.

projects.title: PaginationPilot
projects.problemSolved: Offset pagination skipped and repeated rows as data changed.
projects.keyMechanism: Implemented cursor pagination over a stable composite ordering with a page-size ceiling.
projects.lesson: Cursors kept large lists fast and consistent.

projects.title: UploadUplift
projects.problemSolved: Large uploads failed late and had to restart from zero.
projects.keyMechanism: Split uploads into chunks with checksums and resumable offsets.
projects.lesson: Failure recovery was designed before performance tuning.

projects.title: MailMerge
projects.problemSolved: Templated emails looked different across clients and escaped content badly.
projects.keyMechanism: Built a sandboxed template renderer with a preview mode and automatic escaping.
projects.lesson: Previewing before sending eliminated the most embarrassing class of bug.

projects.title: CacheGateway
projects.problemSolved: Every request hit the origin service even when nothing had changed.
projects.keyMechanism: Added ETags, conditional requests and stale-while-revalidate behaviour.
projects.lesson: The caching lessons fed directly into the later API metrics work.

projects.title: ApiLedger
projects.problemSolved: Third-party usage was invisible until the bill arrived.
projects.keyMechanism: Recorded per-client call counts, latency and error rates in a SQLite ledger with daily rollups.
projects.lesson: Metering first, optimisation second.

projects.title: FrameFinder
projects.problemSolved: Raw tabular data contained duplicates, mixed types and missing values.
projects.keyMechanism: Built a cleaning pipeline with assertions on row counts, null rates and dtypes at each stage.
projects.lesson: Assertions made data failures loud instead of silent.

projects.title: NumberNurse
projects.problemSolved: Numeric drift and wrong dtypes distorted aggregates.
projects.keyMechanism: Vectorised computations with NumPy and made dtype promotion explicit at boundaries.
projects.lesson: Explicit dtypes prevented mysterious precision loss.

projects.title: PlotPilot
projects.problemSolved: Charts exaggerated small differences through truncated axes.
projects.keyMechanism: Standardised baselines, labels and colourblind-safe palettes on every plot.
projects.lesson: Honest defaults did more for trust than a fancier chart library.

projects.title: SparkScope
projects.problemSolved: Feature scaling leaked information from test folds into training.
projects.keyMechanism: Compared StandardScaler and MinMax scaling inside pipelines with leakage checks.
projects.lesson: Pipelines made the correct sequence the easiest one.

projects.title: ModelMeter
projects.problemSolved: Overall accuracy hid poor performance on minority classes.
projects.keyMechanism: Used stratified splits, confusion matrices and per-class precision/recall reporting.
projects.lesson: The model was only as good as its worst important class.

projects.title: ClusterCompass
projects.problemSolved: Cluster count was chosen by eyeballing a chart.
projects.keyMechanism: Scored candidate k values with elbow and silhouette methods and recorded stability across seeds.
projects.lesson: Unstable clusters were reported as uncertainty rather than insight.

projects.title: TextTide
projects.problemSolved: Raw text corpora were dominated by noise and stop words.
projects.keyMechanism: Built a tokenisation and TF-IDF baseline with reproducible cleaning steps.
projects.lesson: A simple baseline set a bar that complex models had to beat.

projects.title: ForecastFoil
projects.problemSolved: Time-series models trained on future information looked unrealistically good.
projects.keyMechanism: Used rolling-origin splits plus lagged features with a strict temporal cutoff.
projects.lesson: Chronological discipline mattered more than model choice.

projects.title: RecoRack
projects.problemSolved: Recommendations simply surfaced the most popular items to everyone.
projects.keyMechanism: Compared a popularity baseline with a lightweight collaborative filter on per-user metrics.
projects.lesson: A strong baseline exposed where personalisation actually helped.

projects.title: NotebookNudge
projects.problemSolved: Notebook results could not be reproduced from a clean checkout.
projects.keyMechanism: Parameterised runs, pinned seeds and exported the final pipeline as a script.
projects.lesson: Reproducibility turned experiments into engineering artifacts.

projects.title: PWAPacket
projects.problemSolved: The app disappeared completely without a network connection.
projects.keyMechanism: Applied a cache-first strategy for the shell and a network-first strategy for data with offline fallbacks.
projects.lesson: Offline behaviour was a design decision, not an accident.

projects.title: NotifyNode
projects.problemSolved: Notification requests interrupted users and drove opt-outs.
projects.keyMechanism: Gated prompts behind a user action, added topic preferences and quiet hours.
projects.lesson: Asking later and explaining why improved opt-in rates.

projects.title: GeoGuide
projects.problemSolved: Location features broke when permission was denied or accuracy was poor.
projects.keyMechanism: Added permission fallbacks, accuracy thresholds and manual entry as an equal path.
projects.lesson: Every sensor feature needs a manual alternative.

projects.title: MediaMixer
projects.problemSolved: Playback controls disagreed with the actual media state.
projects.keyMechanism: Made a single state object authoritative and derived every control from it.
projects.lesson: One source of truth removed an entire category of UI races.

projects.title: IndexedInbox
projects.problemSolved: Offline writes were lost when the page reloaded.
projects.keyMechanism: Queued actions in IndexedDB transactions and replayed them on reconnect with idempotent keys.
projects.lesson: The offline queue reused the same guarantees as server-side queues.

projects.title: CameraCanvas
projects.problemSolved: Uploaded photos appeared rotated on some devices.
projects.keyMechanism: Normalised EXIF orientation into the canvas before export and stored a fixed output format.
projects.lesson: Normalising at ingestion saved every downstream consumer.

projects.title: BarcodeBridge
projects.problemSolved: Keyboard-wedge scanners produced partial or duplicated input.
projects.keyMechanism: Captured rapid key bursts, validated check digits and deduplicated scans by timestamp.
projects.lesson: Treating hardware as a noisy API made scanning reliable.

projects.title: MapMarker
projects.problemSolved: Thousands of markers froze the page.
projects.keyMechanism: Culled markers outside the viewport and clustered dense regions before rendering.
projects.lesson: Rendering less data was the best performance optimisation.

projects.title: CheckoutChrome
projects.problemSolved: Payment forms caused abandonment through unclear errors and rigid inputs.
projects.keyMechanism: Added input masking, inline accessible errors and a summary that survives validation failures.
projects.lesson: Friction removed from a form is worth more than pixels polished elsewhere.

projects.title: SurveyStack
projects.problemSolved: Branching survey logic was hard-coded and impossible to reuse.
projects.keyMechanism: Modelled questions, conditions and validation as JSON and rendered one generic form engine.
projects.lesson: Schema-driven UI cut the cost of each new survey to a data edit.

projects.title: PolicyLint
projects.problemSolved: Access policies drifted between environments with no automated check.
projects.keyMechanism: Parsed policy files into a normalised rule set and stored violations in SQLite with severity levels.
projects.lesson: Policy checks became a build step instead of a meeting.

projects.title: AccessMap
projects.problemSolved: Nobody could answer who could reach a given resource.
projects.keyMechanism: Flattened roles, groups and grants into a queryable SQLite graph with path explanation.
projects.lesson: An explainable access query replaced a week of manual spreadsheet review.

projects.title: AuditTrail
projects.problemSolved: Administrative actions were logged incompletely and out of order.
projects.keyMechanism: Wrote append-only events with monotonic sequence numbers and hash chaining for tamper evidence.
projects.lesson: Append-only records made the history trustworthy.

projects.title: SecretsVault
projects.problemSolved: Secrets were copied between environments in plain text.
projects.keyMechanism: Stored encrypted values with per-environment keys, short-lived unlocks and full redaction in logs.
projects.lesson: Convenience and secrecy were balanced by explicit unlock windows.

projects.title: ConsentLedger
projects.problemSolved: Consent changes could not be reproduced for a specific point in time.
projects.keyMechanism: Recorded versioned consent events and reconstructed state with an as-of query.
projects.lesson: Event sourcing made historical consent auditable.

projects.title: RetentionClock
projects.problemSolved: Data retention rules were applied manually and unevenly.
projects.keyMechanism: Attached retention classes to records and scheduled dry-run deletion with impact previews.
projects.lesson: Showing what would be deleted before doing it built trust in automation.

projects.title: OutboxRelay
projects.problemSolved: Database writes succeeded while follow-up messages were lost.
projects.keyMechanism: Wrote events to an outbox table in the same transaction and relayed them with retry state.
projects.lesson: Transactional outbox removed dual-write failures.

projects.title: RetryBudget
projects.problemSolved: Retry storms amplified a brief outage into a sustained one.
projects.keyMechanism: Tracked per-key retry budgets with jittered exponential backoff and a hard circuit ceiling.
projects.lesson: Retries need a budget, not just a policy.

projects.title: DeadLetterDesk
projects.problemSolved: Failed jobs vanished or were replayed without diagnosis.
projects.keyMechanism: Moved exhausted messages to a dead-letter table with reason codes and one-command replay.
projects.lesson: Making failure visible made recovery routine.

projects.title: PriorityQueue
projects.problemSolved: Urgent work waited behind a FIFO backlog.
projects.keyMechanism: Added priority lanes with fair aging so low-priority jobs could not starve.
projects.lesson: Fairness was an explicit property, not a side effect.

projects.title: ThrottleLab
projects.problemSolved: Different throttle algorithms behaved differently under bursts.
projects.keyMechanism: Simulated fixed window, sliding window and token bucket policies against the same traffic traces.
projects.lesson: Simulation made an invisible policy choice measurable.

projects.title: QuotaLedger
projects.problemSolved: Quota counters reset inconsistently across restarts.
projects.keyMechanism: Persisted atomic counters and window boundaries in SQLite with idempotent charge keys.
projects.lesson: Durable counters made quotas enforceable.

projects.title: MetricsBeacon
projects.problemSolved: Service health was checked by reading logs by hand.
projects.keyMechanism: Exposed a tiny stdlib metrics endpoint for counters, gauges and uptime with no dependencies.
projects.lesson: A small, boring endpoint became the foundation for later dashboards.

projects.title: HealthProbe
projects.problemSolved: Readiness and liveness were treated as the same signal.
projects.keyMechanism: Separated shallow liveness from dependency-aware readiness with time-bounded checks.
projects.lesson: Restarting a service that cannot reach its database solves nothing.

projects.title: TraceContext
projects.problemSolved: Requests crossing components lost their correlation identifiers.
projects.keyMechanism: Propagated a trace ID through logs, queue messages and HTTP headers with a shared helper.
projects.lesson: One identifier tied the whole request story together.

projects.title: DriftCheck
projects.problemSolved: Configuration drift between staging and production was discovered only during incidents.
projects.keyMechanism: Go workers hash manifests concurrently behind a bounded semaphore; Python stores signed snapshots in SQLite and emits a zero-TypeScript diff dashboard.
projects.lesson: Concurrent scanning keeps checks fast while SQLite snapshots make every drift finding reproducible.

projects.title: QueryLens
projects.problemSolved: Slow SQLite queries were optimized by guesswork rather than evidence.
projects.keyMechanism: Python parses EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN output, Go runs timed replays in parallel, and a static HTML report ranks suspected missing indexes.
projects.lesson: Plans, not opinions, drive index decisions in the capstone data tools.

projects.title: CertWatch
projects.problemSolved: Expired TLS certificates caused avoidable outages.
projects.keyMechanism: A Go worker pool performs bounded TLS dials with timeouts, while Python records expiry and renewal state in SQLite for a Vanilla JS status board.
projects.lesson: Certificate health became a continuously checked invariant instead of a calendar reminder.

projects.title: TokenMeter
projects.problemSolved: Token expiry and claim misuse were discovered only after rejected requests.
projects.keyMechanism: Python validates standard JWT claims with the standard library, Go verifies batches concurrently, and SQLite keeps an auditable usage ledger.
projects.lesson: Batch verification stays fast without dropping claim-level audit detail.

projects.title: PortGuard
projects.problemSolved: Local development failed with confusing port collisions.
projects.keyMechanism: Go probes candidate TCP ports with concurrent dials and strict timeouts, Python claims reservations in SQLite, and a small HTML view shows the map.
projects.lesson: Bounded concurrency turns a slow sequential port scan into an instant check.

projects.title: SchemaDiff
projects.problemSolved: Migrations diverged from the schema they claimed to produce.
projects.keyMechanism: Python introspects SQLite via PRAGMA and computes a deterministic diff; a Go CI binary fails the build when unexpected changes appear.
projects.lesson: A deterministic schema diff is the cheapest guardrail in a small data platform.

projects.title: RateLimitSim
projects.problemSolved: Rate limit policies behaved differently under real burst patterns than on paper.
projects.keyMechanism: Go simulates token buckets with goroutines and atomic counters, Python stores scenarios in SQLite, and a no-library canvas view plots rejections.
projects.lesson: Concurrency and visualization together expose bursts that averages hide.

projects.title: LedgerRecon
projects.problemSolved: Balances disagreed across imported ledgers with no obvious source.
projects.keyMechanism: Python performs double-entry reconciliation inside SQLite transactions while Go parses large input files in parallel with checksum verification.
projects.lesson: Transactional reconciliation plus parallel parsing scales without sacrificing correctness.

projects.title: EnvGuard
projects.problemSolved: Secrets and environment mistakes could leak into built frontend assets.
projects.keyMechanism: Go scans files with compiled regex rules in parallel, Python classifies and stores findings in SQLite, and a plain HTML report guides remediation.
projects.lesson: Fast scanning plus a persisted finding list makes security checks repeatable.

projects.title: IndexAudit
projects.problemSolved: Unused indexes slowed writes while providing no read benefit.
projects.keyMechanism: Python analyses query plans and SQLite statistics, Go orchestrates parallel workload samples, and the static report ranks index candidates.
projects.lesson: Indexes are treated as a cost that must earn its keep.

projects.title: QueueLag
projects.problemSolved: Queue depth looked healthy while individual jobs waited for hours.
projects.keyMechanism: Go workers sample oldest-message timestamps concurrently, Python persists lag history in SQLite, and a Vanilla JS dashboard draws inline sparklines.
projects.lesson: Age distributions reveal backlog pain that a single depth number conceals.

projects.title: TraceWaterfall
projects.problemSolved: Latency spikes were visible but their critical path was not.
projects.keyMechanism: A Go collector buffers spans through channels, Python reconstructs the critical path, and a dependency-free waterfall renderer shows the result.
projects.lesson: Buffered channels absorb bursts while deterministic span ordering keeps the waterfall honest.

projects.title: CircuitBreakerSim
projects.problemSolved: One slow dependency cascaded into a full-service outage.
projects.keyMechanism: Go implements a closed/open/half-open state machine with atomic counters, Python drives failure scenarios from SQLite fixtures, and a zero-TypeScript UI visualises state changes.
projects.lesson: The breaker protects the caller, and the simulator teaches where its thresholds should sit.

projects.title: LogPulse
projects.problemSolved: Log spikes were noticed long after users reported problems.
projects.keyMechanism: Go tails files with goroutines, Python aggregates patterns with compiled regexes into SQLite rollups, and a polling Vanilla JS chart shows live movement.
projects.lesson: Streaming aggregation turns logs into an early-warning signal.

projects.title: ReleaseGate
projects.problemSolved: Release decisions depended on scattered checks and tribal knowledge.
projects.keyMechanism: Go runs the capstone checks in parallel, Python records a signed go/no-go decision in SQLite, and the zero-TypeScript Vercel dashboard presents one release verdict.
projects.lesson: The capstone composes DriftCheck through LogPulse into a single, explainable release decision.
